plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Casa Systems access device. It reports uptime, per-module CPU utilization, memory usage and CPU temperature, and interface traffic, for Casa Systems CMTS and broadband access devices (enterprise PEN 20858).
name: Access

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the total CPU utilization of each Casa module (casaModuleTotalCpuUtilization, reported in hundredths of a percent and divided by 100). Sustained high usage indicates control-plane or data-plane pressure on the module.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: This metric reports the total allocatable memory of each Casa module (casaModuleTotalAllocatableMem, reported in KBytes and converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports the memory currently allocated on each Casa module (casaModuleTotalMemAllocated, reported in KBytes and converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: This metric reports the free memory of each Casa module (casaModuleTotalFreeMem, reported in KBytes and converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the memory utilization of each Casa module, derived as allocated memory divided by total allocatable memory. Sustained high usage can indicate service-table growth or memory leaks.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU temperature of each Casa module in degrees Celsius (casaModuleCpuTemperatureSensor). High temperatures can indicate fan failure, airflow obstruction or high ambient temperature.
